title: SteelTech Inc.
description: SteelTech Inc. SteelTech Inc. (doing business as HeatMaster SS), a Canadian outdoor woodfurnace manufacturer from Winkler, Manitoba, has lost all of its servers.1.370.000 files, 1.5 TB - complete Sage 50 accounting booksfor 2023-2027, both management mail archives, the domain controllerdatabase with password hashes of every employee, and the company's entirescan archive.Most sensitive:- Social Insurance Numbers, dates of birth, addresses and phone numbers  of 183 employees - in plain text, inside the payroll table.- Bank account details of 55 employees (payroll EFT files).- Complete identity sets of underage workers (birth certificates,  Manitoba Health cards, driver licences) - Manitoba Youth Jobs program.- Financial collapse: revenue fell from $26.9M to $17.3M (-36%),  operating loss ~$3.1M, chequing account overdrawn by $1.19M,  $3.5M owed to lender Roynat Capital.- Dealer complaints about rust on brand-new stoves,  refractory cracking, and 14 furnaces with 'missing' serial numbers.- A 2020-2026 archive of workplace injuries, including named  investigations and asbestos correspondence.- Passwords to 73 corporate services in a single Excel file.- A failed IRS registration: US customers were promised the 25C tax  credit the company could not legally arrange.The company is owned by the founder's sons - Ryan, Derek and DevonFriesen - who bought it from their father with borrowed money.
